{{Quote|Who let you out? Where are the guards who were stationed here?|Stormtrooper threatening a group of prisoners|<ref name="INR" />}}
This '''stormtrooper''' was stationed onboard [[Freighter 2716]] in [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology Note" /> as part of a [[Mission to Faos Station|mission to transport]] a massive [[kyber crystal]]. When a group of rebels boarded the [[Orca-class freighter|freighter]], this [[stormtrooper]], along with another, noticed a [[Unidentified Theelin (Freighter 2716)|Theelin]] opening a crate door. They and their fellow [[trooper]] dragged the [[Theelin]] out and demanded the Theelin to tell them who let the prisoners out and where the other guards were. However, the stormtroopers were swiftly ambushed by the rebels – [[Saw Gerrera]], [[Ezra Bridger]], and [[Sabine Wren]] – who [[stun]]ned them and added their bodies to those of the troopers already inside the crate. Soon after, the sabotaged freighter exploded, destroying it as well as the [[Slavin's Star Destroyer|star destroyer]] it was to rendezvous with.<ref name="INR" />
